evals.prompt: Fix all lint warnings in this project
evals.expected_output: Pipeline with 2-3 steps: evaluator (run linter), builder (fix warnings), archivist. No parallelism needed. Should check if already clean before building.
assertions: Uses evaluator to run linter first
Gate rule checks if linter passes after fixes

evals.prompt: Research the authentication timeout bug and fix it
evals.expected_output: Pipeline with 5-6 steps: researcher + evaluator (parallel), strategist, builder, reviewer, archivist. Researcher identifies root cause, strategist generates hypothesis, builder implements fix.
assertions: Researcher and evaluator run in parallel (both depend on nothing)
Strategist depends on both researcher and evaluator
Gate rule after researcher checks for root cause identification
Gate rule after reviewer checks for guard violations

evals.prompt: Profile API latency, optimize the slowest endpoints, and validate the improvements
evals.expected_output: Pipeline with 7-8 steps: researcher (profile) + evaluator (baseline) parallel, strategist, builder + reviewer loop, evaluator (post), optional second builder, archivist. Includes before/after comparison.
assertions: Researcher and evaluator run in parallel for profiling + baseline
Gate rule after post-eval checks for regression
At least 7 steps in the pipeline
